ModMetaData.name: Mounted Arms: Strategic Missiles
ModMetaData.author: Felipe
ModMetaData.description:
Adds ballistic missile launchers that can strike targets on the world map, using Combat Extended's world shelling.
- Tactical ballistic missile launcher: a crewed launcher that fires a heavy guided missile at the local map or at settlements up to 120 world tiles away. - ICBM silo: a powered silo that only fires on command, at settlements up to 500 world tiles away. Conventional heavy warhead. - With Dubs Rimatomics: nuclear ICBMs built around its fission warheads, using Rimatomics' own nuclear blast and fallout. - Multiple rocket launcher (HIMARS class): salvos of guided rockets, local map or up to 40 world tiles. - Cruise missile launcher: a fixed block of vertical launch cells; slow, very precise strikes up to 400 world tiles away. - M777 155 mm howitzer, firing Combat Extended 155 mm shells up to 60 world tiles away. - Special warheads for tactical missiles and ICBMs: cluster, thermobaric and EMP (the answer to mechanoid hives). - Missile defense battery: radar-guided interceptors that shoot down incoming artillery shells, ballistic missiles and drop pods.
Spacer, ultra and archotech factions can retaliate against your strikes with ballistic missiles.
Requires Combat Extended. Companion to Mounted Arms, but does not depend on it.
